lab-alibaba: lab-alibaba alibaba the technology company whose qwen team develops the qwen models, served by alibaba cloud through model studio. alibaba group holding limited is a cayman islands holding company with an executive office in hong kong; the principal executive offices of its major businesses are in hangzhou. its qwen team develops the models, publishes them under the qwen organizations, and builds qwen code, and alibaba cloud operates model studio. the catalog names the developer alibaba for most releases and qwen for two, and names the model studio operator alibaba cloud, so all three names belong to this record. alibaba qwen alibaba cloud
lab-amazon: lab-amazon amazon the technology company that develops the amazon nova models and builds amazon bedrock, amazon quick, kiro, and the strands agents sdk. amazon develops the nova models, and amazon web services, of seattle, serves them through amazon bedrock and builds amazon quick, amazon bedrock agentcore, kiro, and the strands agents sdk. the catalog names the developer amazon and the bedrock operator amazon web services, so both names belong to this record. amazon amazon web services
lab-anthropic: lab-anthropic anthropic the ai company that develops the claude models and builds the claude apps, claude code, and the anthropic api on them. anthropic pbc, a public benefit corporation based and headquartered in the united states, develops the models and runs the products; anthropic ireland, limited contracts with customers in the european economic area, switzerland, and the uk. its board is elected by stockholders and by the long-term benefit trust, which is not a parent company. one name, anthropic, covers the models, the api, and the specifications it stewards. anthropic
lab-cohere: lab-cohere cohere the ai company that develops the command models for enterprise use and, through its research lab cohere labs, the aya and north releases. cohere inc., with its principal place of business in toronto, develops the command models and operates the cohere api; cohere labs, its research lab, publishes the aya and north releases under the coherelabs organization. the catalog names the developer cohere or cohere labs release by release, so both names belong to this record. cohere cohere labs
lab-deepseek: lab-deepseek deepseek the ai company that develops the deepseek v, r, and ocr models and runs the deepseek app and api on them. hangzhou deepseek artificial intelligence co., ltd. develops the models and provides the deepseek app and the deepseek api under its own terms, and publishes weights and the deepseek harness under its deepseek-ai organizations. one name, deepseek, covers the models, the api, and the products. deepseek
lab-google: lab-google google the technology company whose google deepmind unit develops the gemini and gemma models that google serves through the gemini api, vertex ai, and the gemini apps. google deepmind develops the models. google llc, of mountain view and the largest of alphabet inc.'s companies, offers the gemini api, the gemini apps, and the developer tools, while google cloud operates vertex ai and the gemini enterprise agent platform. the catalog names the developer google for most releases and google deepmind for one, and names the vertex ai operator google cloud, so all three names belong to this record. google google deepmind google cloud alphabet inc.
lab-meta: lab-meta meta the technology company that develops the llama and muse models and builds meta ai, muse code, and the meta model api on them. meta platforms, inc., of menlo park, develops the models and operates the meta model api. the catalog names the developer meta and the api operator meta platforms, so both names belong to this record. llama weights are published under the meta-llama organization and muse glimmer's under meta-models. meta meta platforms
lab-microsoft: lab-microsoft microsoft the technology company that develops the mai and phi models and builds the copilot assistants, microsoft foundry, and several agent frameworks. microsoft corporation, of redmond, develops the mai models through microsoft ai and publishes the phi models and onnx runtime genai, and microsoft azure operates microsoft foundry models. the catalog names the developer and runtime maintainer microsoft and the foundry operator microsoft azure, so both names belong to this record. microsoft microsoft azure
lab-minimax: lab-minimax minimax the ai company that develops the minimax m-series language models, alongside speech, music, and video models, and offers them through the minimax open platform. minimax group inc., a shanghai-based holding company listed on the hong kong stock exchange, develops the models and runs the minimax open platform; its international apps are contracted through nanonoble pte. ltd. of singapore. one name, minimax, covers the models and the platform. minimax
lab-mistral-ai: lab-mistral-ai mistral ai the ai company that develops the mistral, ministral, magistral, devstral, and voxtral models and runs mistral ai studio and the mistral vibe assistant on them. mistral ai, a french simplified joint-stock company registered in paris, develops the models, operates mistral ai studio and its api, and runs mistral vibe, the assistant it renamed from le chat. one name, mistral ai, covers the models, the service, and the assistant. mistral ai
lab-moonshot-ai: lab-moonshot-ai moonshot ai the ai company that develops the kimi models and offers them through the moonshot ai open platform. beijing moonshot technology co., ltd. (北京月之暗面科技有限公司), based in haidian, beijing, develops the models and operates the kimi api platform. it trades as moonshot ai and brands its models and assistant kimi; the catalog uses the one name moonshot ai for the models and the platform. moonshot ai
lab-nvidia: lab-nvidia nvidia the accelerated-computing company that develops the nemotron models, serves models through the nvidia api catalog, and maintains the tensorrt llm runtime. nvidia corporation, of santa clara, develops the nemotron models, operates the nvidia api catalog, and maintains tensorrt llm. one name, nvidia, covers the models, the service, and the runtime. nvidia
lab-openai: lab-openai openai the ai company that develops the gpt, o-series, and gpt-oss models and builds chatgpt, codex, and the openai api on them. openai group pbc, a public benefit corporation controlled by the nonprofit openai foundation, develops the models and runs the products; the october 2025 recapitalization set this structure. its privacy policy names openai opco, llc, of san francisco. one name, openai, covers the models, the api, and the specifications it co-stewards. openai openai foundation
lab-xai: lab-xai spacexai (xai) the ai company, formerly xai, that develops the grok models and builds grok, grok bot, and the xai api on them. spacex completed its acquisition of xai on 2 february 2026, making it a wholly owned subsidiary, and xai now calls itself spacexai; its policies name spacexai llc. the catalog names the developer xai or spacexai (xai) release by release and names the api operator xai, so both names belong to this record. xai spacexai (xai) spacex (space exploration technologies corp.)
lab-z-ai: lab-z-ai z.ai the ai company, known in china as zhipu, that develops the glm models and builds the z.ai assistant, zcode, and the z.ai and bigmodel apis on them. beijing zhipu huazhang technology (北京智谱华章科技股份有限公司) develops the glm models and operates the zhipu ai open platform (bigmodel) in china, while the international z.ai model api is contracted through jingsheng hengxing technology pte. ltd. of singapore. the catalog uses the brand and both entity names, so all three belong to this record. z.ai jingsheng hengxing technology pte. ltd. (z.ai) 北京智谱华章科技股份有限公司 (beijing zhipu huazhang technology)
